actions.action: Water lightly the day before dividing
Tip out the clump and gently pull the pilea's section away, keeping soil on its roots
Snip any tangled roots with clean scissors
Pot each plant in an 8–10 cm pot with a drainage hole, filled with houseplant potting mix
Water each newly potted plant until water drains out the bottom
Place the pilea in bright, indirect light
Every 2–3 days, check the pilea's soil with a finger and water when the top 1 cm is dry

reason: The thread's fix was rearranging the plants so the Kalanchoe gets the most light, but the answer calls all three plants healthy and focuses on dividing and repotting, never addressing light placement; its advice is not damaging, though.
